hypothesis: This package is corpus scaffolding, not an experiment. It fetches and caches the pre-1859 biology, natural history, geology, and philosophy-of-science documents named for Case 2 of the multi-case retrospective test in papers/dynamics_of_conceptual_deletion/paper.md (Darwin / species fixity, 1859). It makes no scientific claim; success is defined as every named Wikisource source fetching to substantive text.

controls.description: Every source is pulled through the same throttled Wikisource api.php pipeline used by experiments/date_cut_retrodiction/fetch.py and experiments/lavoisier_phlogiston_corpus/fetch.py; the container-extraction and chrome-removal logic is imported, not copied, so all three corpora share provenance.
results/fetch_summary.json records the character count and SHA-256 of every cached document, so a re-fetch that silently produces different bytes is detectable.

Any cached document below 2000 characters is flagged as non-substantive in the summary. All 32 sources in the corpus cleared this threshold on the 2026-07-27 fetch (smallest was the Zoonomia Preface at 4200 characters); the threshold is preserved as a safety net for any regression.

Three pre-1859 documents carry provenance_risk=True in corpus.py: darwin_1845_beagle_ch8 and darwin_1845_beagle_ch17 (Wikisource transcription drawn from the 1860 John Murray reprint of the 1845 second edition of Journal of Researches; content year 1845, vehicle year 1860 which postdates Origin by one year, and author had privately abandoned species fixity by 1845), and wallace_darwin_1858_linnean (the 1858 Linnean Society joint communication that first publicly names natural selection; content and vehicle both 1858, one year before Origin). CORPUS_MANIFEST.md documents the structural reason and requires any downstream analysis to run with and without these three sources.

CORPUS_MANIFEST.md enumerates every pre-1859 author named in the DCD paper's Case 2 sketch (Lyell, Chambers, Cuvier, Lamarck, Whewell, Owen, Buffon) that is absent from Wikisource main namespace, with the specific reason (missing author page, empty author page, or only later / biographical works listed). No fabricated substitutes; no silent substitution of later editions.

gates.criterion: Every SourceSpec in experiments.darwin_species_fixity_corpus.corpus.SOURCES fetches to a cached text file, and each cached file passes the 2000-character substantive-content threshold, as recorded in results/fetch_summary.json.
